name: Real-Time Object Detection Benchmarks
description: A set of datasets and evaluation protocols designed to measure object detection performance under real-time (speed and accuracy) constraints.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) combined with runtime (frames-per-second) / speed-accuracy tradeoff
general_score_metric: mean Average Precision (mAP) often reported alongside runtime (FPS)
typical_sota_score: ≈40–55% mAP for real-time-capable models (reported ranges vary by dataset and FPS constraint)
reputation: Widely used as a reference for evaluating speed-vs-accuracy tradeoffs in real-time object detection research and engineering.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; scores highly dependent on hardware and implementation; multiple protocol variants exist (so results can be hard to compare directly).
